description: Finds why a PostgreSQL query is slow from its EXPLAIN output, in text or JSON: where the time goes, and problems such as sequential scans throwing away rows, wrong row estimates, sorts and hashes spilling to disk, and nested loops run many times. Use after running EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS). It only reads the text you give it and never connects to a database. Suggested indexes are candidates to test.

path.description: Path to a file holding EXPLAIN output. Give this or plan

plan.description: EXPLAIN output as text or JSON. Give this or path

name: postgres_plan_review
title: Review a PostgreSQL query plan
